name: fi-credit-proof
description: Root orchestrator for the fi-credit-proof monorepo (frontend + verifier + tlsn-plugin + solana-program).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix verifier-server install && npm --prefix tlsn-plugin install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n verifier,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:verifier" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:plugin
scripts.build:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:plugin && npm run build:program
scripts.clean: rm -rf frontend/dist frontend/node_modules verifier-server/node_modules tlsn-plugin/dist tlsn-plugin/node_modules solana-program/target node_modules
